name: "SUPER 30" Scheme
benefit: The scheme covers the coaching fees (capped at ₹1,00,000/-) & the accommodation fees of ₹1,40,000/- per annum (with 5% extra in 2nd year), for attaining a two-year coaching programme for JEE/ NEET at a nationally reputed Coaching Institution outside Tripura.
_eligibility_text:
1. The applicant should be a resident of Tripura. 
1. The applicant should be a student.
1. The applicant should belong to the Scheduled Tribe (ST)/ Scheduled Caste (SC)/ Person with Disability (PH) community.
1. The student should have passed the class-10th Pre-Board/ Pre-Test Exam from the government-recognized school of Tripura with 50% marks.
1. The applicant should be appearing for the class 10th board final exam.
1. The annual income of the family of the applicant should not exceed ₹1,00,000/-.
